definitions: The structured process by which new users or organizations are integrated into the SAP LeanIX platform, often involving setup, training, and initial configuration to ensure effective use of the software.
The initial phase of user adoption for the SAP LeanIX suite of tools, designed to familiarize users with its functionalities and best practices.
examples: The SAP LeanIX Onboarding process was smooth.
We completed SAP LeanIX Onboarding last week.
Effective SAP LeanIX Onboarding is crucial for user adoption.
